expected_findings.summary: `([a-zA-Z0-9]+[._-]?)+` nests a quantifier inside a quantified group; a non-matching input like 40 'a' characters causes catastrophic backtracking and blocks the event loop on user-supplied signup data. Use a linear pattern (`^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+@...`), cap the input length, or use a validator library.

must_stay_silent_on.reason: Linear, anchored character-class regex; no nested quantifiers.
